title: Call notes: PPS-2 retrofit kits and install crews

messages.text: Kits on hand at the four distribution centres cover the worst kitchens first; everything else is on the supplier lead time.
Three crews available, one overnight install per crew per night, starting the night after a kit lands.
Linda Hartmann's pilot kitchens held window time through the launch. Rank the installs by revenue at risk, not by who asks first.
